adaptationNotes: OTServBR Lua combat logic is adapted to Kaetram TypeScript combat; Lua is not executed directly.
All 688 spell records are exposed through OT Skills and /otcast.
Offensive spells are mapped to target/self/area/wave/beam Kaetram damage behavior.
Healing/support/conjuring/familiar/house/summon spells use Kaetram healing/mana sustain equivalents when no direct engine mechanic exists.
The 25 OTBM maps are structurally sampled and fitted into independent 48x36 Kaetram regions; floor/wall/water geometry and collision intent are preserved in adapted form.
Each map spawn is placed in the largest reachable walkable component available after conversion.
OpenTibia Sprite Pack effects are adapted into a 10-row x 8-frame animated atlas.
